scope: Second source-screening batch; temporary adult image review only

sources.label: Modified Cupid’s-bow lip shaping
sources.title: The Modified Cupid's Bow Lips: A Dominant Aesthetic Trend in Lip Augmentation—A Clinical and Statistical Analysis
sources.current_use: Candidate for Heart-style shape review; not an exact match to our Heart or Russian presets.
sources.limitations: Follow-up timing, full image framing and independent scale must be checked. Image retrieval was unavailable in this session.
sources.consent_review: Informed consent reported; independent permission for training or redistribution not established.
sources.figure_specific_rights_status: No separate restrictive credit identified in reviewed captions; not a blanket clearance for training or redistribution.

sources.label: General lip volume and contour
sources.title: The Redefinition and Volumization of the Lip Area with Hyaluronic Acid: A Case Series
sources.current_use: General lip-volume reference. Figure 3 includes baseline, 2 weeks and 3 months.
sources.limitations: Figure 2 is immediate; do not treat swelling as a healed outcome. Figure overlap may repeat one person. Image retrieval was unavailable in this session.
sources.consent_review: Written participation consent and use of anonymized clinical data for scientific purposes reported.
sources.figure_specific_rights_status: No separate restrictive credit identified in reviewed captions; not a blanket clearance for training or redistribution.

sources.label: Comparison of four lip injection techniques
sources.title: Comparing the Effects of Different Injection Techniques Used in Lip Augmentation on Filler Migration and Patient Satisfaction
sources.limitations: Figure 2 shows immediate appearances, not a verified set of healed matched pairs. No direct Russian-style validation.
sources.consent_review: Informed consent reported; declarations also say obtained or waived.
sources.figure_specific_rights_status: No separate restrictive credit identified in reviewed captions; not a blanket clearance for training or redistribution.

sources.label: Under-eye filler
sources.title: Bridging the Gap Rather Than Filling the Entire Valley—Anatomic Insights When Treating the Medial Infraorbital Region
sources.adult_evidence: Cohort ages 21–46; illustrated cases ages 35 and 38.
sources.current_use: Two before/after figure candidates; six-month cohort assessment.
sources.limitations: Cropped framing, photo comparability and figure-specific timing still require inspection; no new measurements.
sources.consent_review: No explicit consent statement found in the retrieved XML; publication provenance recorded, broader reuse not asserted.
sources.figure_specific_rights_status: No separate restrictive credit identified in reviewed captions; not a blanket clearance for training or redistribution.

sources.label: Under-eye surgery with orbital fat filling
sources.title: Application of infraorbital rim augmentation with pocket fat filling to correct tear trough deformity
sources.adult_evidence: Cohort ages 25–59; illustrated cases ages 32, 46 and 55.
sources.current_use: Three pairs visually screened; reference only.
sources.limitations: All three crop out mouth/chin needed by the current full-face metrics. Different lighting/pose/expression; combined fat removal and filling cannot isolate one generic procedure.
sources.consent_review: Written consent for publication of identifiable images explicitly reported.
sources.figure_specific_rights_status: No separate restrictive credit identified in reviewed captions; not a blanket clearance for training or redistribution.

sources.label: Nonsurgical nose filler
sources.title: Standardized Non-surgical Rhinoplasty with Hyaluronic Acid: Consistent Outcomes Across Injectors with Varying Experience
sources.adult_evidence: Cohort ages 20–60; illustrated adults ages 25, 26, 34 and 35.
sources.current_use: Four candidate before/after figures with documented injection totals.
sources.limitations: Actual photo timing and image quality need review. Patient-reported effect duration is not the date of the after photograph. Filler augmentation must not calibrate surgical reduction.
sources.figure_specific_rights_status: Publisher includes images under article license unless a credit line excludes them; full-resolution credit review outstanding.
sources.catalog_mapping: No exact procedure ID in the current catalog; do not map to surgical rhinoplasty.
